name: kimi-quota-statusline-secure
description: A minimal, privacy-focused Kimi Code status line showing remaining 5-hour, 7-day, and monthly quotas.

interface.shortDescription: Remaining Kimi quotas with no hooks, session-log access, or local HTTP server.
interface.longDescription: Displays remaining 5h, 7d, and monthly Kimi Code quotas. Uses only the official Kimi usages API over allowlisted HTTPS endpoints. No third-party dependencies, OAuth token persistence, prompt hooks, session-log reads, debug snapshots, or HTTP server.
